name: Usopp
description: Through-Wano Usopp sniper with Kuro Kabuto, specialized ammunition and Pop Greens. Observation Haki grants purchased concealment detection, not future sight. Traps are adapted as pulses/lines; no transformation, healing or persistent trap placement is claimed. Numbers are gameplay tuning.

paths.name: Kabuto Marksmanship
paths.description: Kuro Kabuto craftsmanship: greater shot power, range, timing, and sight. Range and damage are gameplay adaptations of specialized ammunition and long-distance marksmanship.

upgrades.name: Reinforced Star Payload
upgrades.description: Adds flat damage to every ordinary Kuro Kabuto shot, adapting Usopp's specialized ammunition.

upgrades.name: Long-Range Band Tension
upgrades.description: Extends primary acquisition reach for extreme-distance sniping.

upgrades.name: Dial-Stabilized Release
upgrades.description: Reduces primary timing through improved stability and projectile spin.

upgrades.name: Sharp-Eyed Lookout
upgrades.description: Purchased Observation Haki detection reveals concealed eligible targets; this is an imperfect sense, not future sight.

upgrades.name: Kabuto Power Tuning
upgrades.description: Multiplies ordinary primary damage to represent a stronger Kuro Kabuto shot.

paths.name: Pop Green Arsenal
paths.description: Pop Green ammunition adapts documented plants, tunnel traps, wolf shockwaves and bamboo growth into contact pulse/line effects; exact plant strength is gameplay tuning.

upgrades.name: Aggressive Seed Mix
upgrades.description: Adds flat damage to ordinary shots by incorporating more forceful Pop Green payloads.

upgrades.name: Wolf-Bulb Shock Trap
upgrades.description: Every second successful primary cycle emits a short-area Pop Green shockwave that can stun eligible weak-willed targets.

upgrades.name: Bamboo Tunnel Burst
upgrades.description: Every third successful primary cycle emits a damaging line from the contact point, adapting erupting bamboo and prepared tunnel traps.

upgrades.name: Super Grow Up Shot
upgrades.description: Extends primary reach through the larger Kuro Kabuto configuration used for particularly long-range attacks.

upgrades.name: Predatory Pop Green
upgrades.description: Multiplies ordinary projectile and Pop Green damage for more dangerous carnivorous and explosive growths.

paths.name: Deception and Dials
paths.description: Deception, Dials and observation provide faster corrections, retargeting, a limited Impact Dial armor adaptation, and Firebird-style power. No future sight is implied.

upgrades.name: Quick Bluff Draw
upgrades.description: Reduces primary timing through a faster deceptive setup and release.

upgrades.name: Calculated Correction
upgrades.description: Allows one lost primary target to be replaced at resolution without restarting its windup.

upgrades.name: Impact Dial Counterforce
upgrades.description: Adds limited armor ignore as a gameplay adaptation of Impact Dial force return; it is not Armament Haki.

upgrades.name: Firebird Star
upgrades.description: Adds flat damage to ordinary shots, adapting the named long-range Firebird Star as a stronger ammunition choice.

upgrades.name: Fear and Misdirection
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary damage after deceptive openings and psychological pressure create a cleaner shot.
